_comment: Per-arch HP grid for train_segmentation.py --hp-grid. Top-level keys=arch names. Keys: lr, weight_decay, warmup_epochs, sched_power, scheduler(polynomial|cosine), optimizer(adamw|adam|sgd), momentum(sgd), grad_clip(0=off), batch_size. Symmetric sweep: each arch has 3 AdamW + 2 SGD base configs, each crossed with batch_size {4,8,16} = 15 runs/arch, 30 total. bs=16 at 256px may OOM on 16GB VRAM (esp. segformer).
